about: Lines of code (js, mjs, ts, css, html, py) per area, with ~3% slack: tools/budgets.ts. An area over its budget fails lint; raise a budget only with a new reason describing its current contents and size.

..reason: The server entry point exits on an uncaught exception after saving, for systemd to restart it. The root holds the server entry point and the Vite, Vitest and Playwright configurations; Vitest sizes its forks to the memory its cgroups leave.

core.reason: The pattern core the browser, the boxes and the server share: the runtime pattern-core.ts re-exports, the FSEQ writer and the scrubber. Export's shape and frame packing live in fseq.ts, where the export test runs them. Prepared blur kernels cache exact weights and sums, nearest-LED cells store flat coordinates, and integrated clocks cache repeated reads within a frame.

public.reason: The app and sandbox HTML shells load their browser entry points.

public/css.reason: The privacy page's panels and the sign-in page's link to it. People's rows. The Account page's forms. Responsive Studio, phone disclosures, navigation and full-size tap targets.

public/js.reason: Sign-in's Try it lets a visitor in as a guest in one click. New look opens a Start a look picker, whose preset becomes the look; a preset auditions with the globals it needs. The privacy page says what Studio keeps, open signed in or not, from sign-in and the user menu. The gallery's moderation: curators hide and unhide cards, and anyone with an account reports a look. People lists accounts to change their role, disable or delete them. The Account page changes a password and deletes an account once its looks are counted. The views load the rig the server names.

public/patterns.reason: Streaks tables per-lane random values and Chase tables common strand ids in frame(), retaining exact fallback calculations outside the tables.

render-box.reason: Parent PID checks stop orphaned library-only bakes between frames, alongside deterministic IDs and streaming FSEQ output.

shared.reason: Shared schemas and pure rules define looks, API data, permissions (who sees a look the gallery has not approved) and playback; one walk over a look's modules serves every rule on them (the save check, the library-only step, refs, a bake's key), and owns the composite rule: no code of its own, at least one sub-layer.

src.reason: Bug reports are kept the days STUDIO_REPORTS_DAYS sets, which the privacy page reads. A bake whose look is deleted or changed while its frames are stored removes them. At start, a look from before the one rule is converted by its code as read and kept as refs, keeps an exact bake against that code, and the hash of the code it was saved with carries into its new order. The gallery lists approved looks to members and every shared one to curators, who hide them. The stats write each ended day's counts to the journal, once, whether a request or a timer ends the day. A save may send a module as its library ref alone, which the library-only check takes when the library has it. A stored module is its library ref: every read fills its code from the library, hidden modules too, in the order a saved module's keys have, and leaves out a bake (and its review) of other code and the review of a version whose code changed, which filters and updates see too; every write and import keeps none, setting the ref by exact file when it names none. People lets admins change an account's role, disable or delete it; a sign-in rereads the account after its password is checked, and a new look its owner. The server brings each data folder under the library-only rule once, backing up first and clearing the bakes and reviews of looks whose code moves (keeping a bake whose frames stay the same), stopping on a library file it cannot read; by hand, it switches modules naming a retired pattern to its closest preset's modules (or drops their layer) and lists each look changed and each edited copy. A module naming a library module is that module, its carried code dropped; only code with no such ref is matched by its exact current file.

test.reason: The one walk over a look's modules is covered: its order at any depth, where a look's shape breaks, its map, and the save check and bake key through it; the library-only step drops a malformed composite. A guest that Try it makes, with no name, is covered. Start a look's audition in place of the look, with the preset's globals, is covered. Report retention's default and the privacy page's route are covered. A look deleted while its bake stores frames leaves none. An old look whose exact conversion inserts a warp stop keeps its bake at start, the stop kept as a ref of radius 0. A look stored before the one rule as refs alone keeps an exact bake at start, its code hash carried, unless the library changed its code or its blur makes the conversion inexact. Gallery moderation is covered: who sees an unapproved or hidden look, its frames and previews, and hiding through edits and re-sharing. The daily backup timer's units, its run with no release left (as after a rollback), its pruning, off-site copy and loud failures, the server's exit on an uncaught exception and the day-end stats line, written once whether a request or its timer ends the day, are covered with stand-ins. Browser specs that played broken modules now break the page's library instead, since looks save only library code; the box's fork bomb ends its own children and the test checks none survive, with no PID namespace to end them. Every library preset's .fseq on the Folly, the Studio's Export and the bake's file, is read back by an independent reader: header, LED channels, fps, frames and sampled frames. Saves of modules as refs alone (hidden ones too), the library list marking hidden modules, and look files without code are covered. Stored modules as refs are covered: reads filled, writes without code, refs by exact file and renamed entries, a library change clearing bakes and reviews (a rebake under way too), versions' reviews, and filters on what a read gives, and the library-only step keeping a look stored as refs. The library-only step switching retired patterns is covered on looks like the owner's, as refs and as code: presets' modules with the params that fit, layers dropped, edited copies listed apart, a second run for folders that had the step. The library-only step on a data folder is covered: what it keeps, moves and drops, its backups, its marker, a dry run, bakes kept or cleared, an unreadable library, the dry run by default, and the server never running it. Deploys are covered release by release (build before switch, rollback, pruning, the lock) with stand-in npm and systemd. An account changing its password and deleting itself (against a stale check or sign-in, with previews made or being made) is covered over HTTP and in the browser. Per-account write-limit and look-size tests. Library-only saving and baking is covered on every path (saves, imports, edits of saved custom looks, composites carrying code, bakes from stored frames), alongside Vampire palette browser coverage atomic settings-file writes and the default rig; browser checks build the app once per run and wait on drawn frames.

tools.reason: Tools build and check rig, palette and rose-expansion data, enforce budgets, support development and backups (pruned to the newest archives for the daily timer), and benchmark rendering.
